title: His Steadfast Love Endures Forever

questions.question: Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; for his steadfast love endures how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:1 (ESV): "Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever!"

questions.question: Let Israel say, "His steadfast love endures how long?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:2 (ESV): "Let Israel say, 'His steadfast love endures forever.'"

questions.question: Let the house of Aaron say, "His steadfast love endures how long?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:3 (ESV): "Let the house of Aaron say, 'His steadfast love endures forever.'"

questions.question: Let those who fear the Lord say, "His steadfast love endures how long?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:4 (ESV): "Let those who fear the Lord say, 'His steadfast love endures forever.'"

questions.question: Out of my distress I called on the Lord; the Lord answered me and set me what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:5 (ESV): "the Lord answered me and set me free."

questions.question: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:6 (ESV): "What can man do to me?"

questions.question: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:8 (ESV): "It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in man."

questions.question: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in whom? (verse 9)
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:9 (ESV): "It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes."

questions.question: The stone that the builders rejected has become the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:22 (ESV): "The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone."

questions.question: This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be what in it?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:24 (ESV): "let us rejoice and be glad in it."

questions.question: Save us, we pray, O Lord! O Lord, we pray, give us what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:25 (ESV): "O Lord, we pray, give us success!"

questions.question: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! We bless you from the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:26 (ESV): "We bless you from the house of the Lord."

questions.question: The Lord is God, and he has made his light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords, up to the horns of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:27 (ESV): "...up to the horns of the altar!"

questions.question: This is the Lord's doing; it is marvelous in our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:23 (ESV): "it is marvelous in our eyes."

questions.question: Who surrounded the psalmist like bees?
questions.explanation: Psalm 118:10-12 (ESV): "All nations surrounded me... They surrounded me like bees;"

key_verse_text: This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
